BRANDING / 07 OF 07

GalzTalk

An identity that starts a conversation.

A visual identity and app concept centred on connection, shared experiences and personal expression.

THE PROJECT

Room for a real conversation.

GalzTalk is a platform concept where women can connect and share experiences anonymously. The design explores a more approachable way to start conversations, express personal experiences and find common ground.

DESIGN DIRECTION

A simple symbol. A personal touch.

The logo combines a speech bubble with a ponytail, bringing conversation and character into one recognisable mark. Clean lettering and a focused pink accent give the identity a distinct voice across the wordmark and app icon.

THE VISUAL LANGUAGE

Expressive, with a clear structure.

Pink#E71461
Ink#131414
Light Grey#E5E5E5
TYPOGRAPHY

Roboto

A clear, familiar sans serif that supports readable conversations and straightforward navigation.

COLOUR IN USE

A recognisable accent.

Pink connects the brand mark with key interface elements, balanced by dark text and light surfaces.

IN APPLICATION

The conversation continues on screen.

The identity extends into an app interface through consistent colour, clear typography and a repeatable layout. Profiles, feeds and navigation share the same visual language, keeping the focus on people and their conversations.
